question: After #1436, does any dumb per-run cost remain on an e9patch cache hit, and does the rewrite cache reliably hit run-to-run?
guest: /var/tmp/biggp — 24 MiB static freestanding, one patchable syscall site
conclusion: No remaining dumb slowness on the warm path (~1ms/run); cold ~1.27s is the inherent one-time e9tool rewrite, amortized by a reliable cache hit.
